title: ID0457468-DC/Si-D/BR-[Y2/R3 313020197004] HMI screen blank
description:
Reported behavior/issue- the HMI screen at Shell Recharge | Saci Station (Y2 R4 313020197004) - LOC, SP-330, SN - KM 84 - Macuco, Valinhos - SP, 13273-609, is blank. This is making it impossible to view the station's information.

yyyy-mm-dd:-

additional_info.subject: Solicitação de Serviço – Manutenção da Estação de Recarga Shell – Estação Y2 R4 313020197004
additional_info.body:
Bom dia a todos
Espero que estejam bem.
Notamos que a tela do IHM do Shell Recharge | Posto Saci  (Y2 R4 313020197004) - LOC, SP-330, SN - KM 84 - Macuco, Valinhos - SP, 13273-609,  está apagada. E isso eventualmente está impossibilitando a visualização das informações da estação.
Por essa razão, solicito a abertura de um chamado de manutenção de garantia para a estação Y2 R4 313020197004, para análise e reparo.
Em anexo a imagem da tela do IHM da estação.
Att,
Adrielly Mendes Batista
C
+
55 (19) 99616-5013
www.raizen.com

additional_info.body:
Dear Service Coordinator / RC,
I am writing to inform that we are moving the case
0457468
﻿from the Technical Support to the eMobility RC-BR SI E Queue. The first response has been sent to the customer, and we kindly ask you to take over the case and perform the necessary troubleshooting steps.
Customer:
Product:
Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset:
Y2 / R3 313020197004
Charger ID / Serial No.:
Charger address/functional location:
Priority:
Medium
Possible solution:
Please measure the Voltage between the 24V supply on the PCB.
If the Voltage is between 24/25V and the HMI is not OK
Verify if the DP cable is properly attached
If both are OK then replace the HMI
I will send you all the necessary references for the specific HMI required for this charger
-Adaptation 8EM5905-0AA00-8AA6
-
8EM5902-1AA00-6AA1 Controlpanel RAFI 3 segments w/o AC cutout
-
8EM5902-1AA02-0AA8  Controlp. RAFI middle segm. contactl. CCR
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-BR SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require expert support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
Kindly close the case post resolution following the case handling guidelines.
Thank you.
With best regards,
